summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $716K in annual savings with $685K already locked in
summary.narrative: Treya Partners delivered a strategic sourcing program that has already finalized $684,936 in recurring annual savings across six spend categories and is tracking an additional $31,459 in savings from IT Managed Services now in late-stage review. Key wins include renegotiating Athena RCM fees, consolidating medical supplies distribution, converting sonography services in-house, and optimizing IUD purchasing and lab services. All finalized categories are already accruing benefits, with first savings beginning in July 2022.
